dataset: Materialized os.urandom bytes; no sparse files
measurement_notes: Server RSS/CPU includes the Windows venv launcher and child process. Other local development work may run concurrently; no isolated disk/network baseline.
fixture_cleanup: Only generated source, server and download fixtures removed after run; logs and checksums retained
verification_metric_note: Sum of per-file time from completion request to observed completion. Includes overlapping verification and time until polling, and can exceed total wall time; not time blocked waiting.
